C-MESSAGE-ONLY-HISTORY-REWRITE.IntentSummary: Extend the deterministic repository safety gate with an isomorphic message-only main-rewrite lane, merge it through PR #54, perform the owner-approved exact commit-message rewrite under a bounded protection window, verify the remote result, and rebase every live PR branch before normal development resumes.

MustContain.Text: The pre-push hook repeats the full scan for every outgoing commit.

MustPassCommand.Command: sh -c 'test "$(git for-each-ref refs/tags --format="%(refname)%00%(objectname)%00%(*objectname)" | LC_ALL=C sort | shasum -a 256 | cut -d" " -f1)" = "0e9eaeb4cc60aa7e3aa6f097cb5fa369611393aea88e107b885fdcf0d6d642b8"'

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The gate recognizes only one non-fast-forward refs/heads/main update and constructs a candidate only after old/new histories match in count, topology, trees, author identity/date and committer identity/date; changed messages and the exact ref update are the complete scan payload.

M-064, V-M-064 and docs/commit-push-safety.md describe the deterministic lane without reintroducing workstation model, GPU, prompt or override logic; PR #54 is green and squash-merged before the rewrite.

A clean disposable clone holds a private recovery ref and exact old/new message map; the candidate contains the same number and topology of commits with byte-identical trees and identical author/committer identities and dates, and only the approved messages differ.

The reviewed candidate is force-pushed to refs/heads/main through the installed pre-push hook while no other ref changes; the protection exception is removed immediately and remote main equals the reviewed new tip.

T-005.Title: Rebase live pull-request branches and verify public state

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: PR #48, #52 and #55 heads are rebased onto rewritten main, no Claude co-author trailer remains reachable from main, existing tag object identities match the frozen digest, and no old-history merge can reintroduce the rewritten ancestry.

Verification.Command: sh -c 'test "$(git for-each-ref refs/tags --format="%(refname)%00%(objectname)%00%(*objectname)" | LC_ALL=C sort | shasum -a 256 | cut -d" " -f1)" = "0e9eaeb4cc60aa7e3aa6f097cb5fa369611393aea88e107b885fdcf0d6d642b8"'

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All target commands and final assertions pass, M-064/V-M-064 match the deployed gate, and the complete bundle is ready for explicit apply confirmation and archival before the separately governed v2.8.2 release anchor.

Approval.ApprovedBy: Owner, 2026-10-24, explicit approval of the message-only rewrite followed by the instruction to execute.
Approval.ExecutionMode: Sequential writes after parallel-safe preflight failed on pre-existing release-plan overlaps; independent audits remain parallel and read-only.
